"description":"Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becoming the person you want to be.

That visible progress is the whole secret behind HabitKit, a beautifully simple habit tracker. When your grid looks this good, you will not want to stop. Fill the tiles, protect your streak, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.

Whether you want to work out more, read every night, meditate, drink more water, save money, or finally quit smoking, HabitKit gives every goal the same simple loop: do it, log it, watch the grid grow. No guilt trips, just daily habit tracking that feels rewarding.

BUILD GOOD HABITS, QUIT BAD ONES
Create the habits you want to grow, or flip it around and quit a habit: every day counts as clean until you log a slip, and your streak counts your clean days in a row. You can even set a daily maximum, like two coffees a day, and simply stay under it instead of going cold turkey.

TRACK YOUR HABITS YOUR WAY
Check a day off with a simple yes or no, count reps like glasses or pages, or measure amounts with your own unit, like 2 L of water or 7.5 km of running. Set daily goals and flexible schedules that fit your routine: every day, specific intervals, or a number of times per week or month.

YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Every habit gets its own tile grid, like a contribution graph, and every completed day fills in a square. See all your habits together on one dashboard, switch between Classic, Compact, and Split views, and share a beautiful snapshot of your progress when you hit a milestone. One glance tells you the whole story: what you did, what you missed, and how far you have come.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Get a friendly nudge exactly when you need it, and never forget a habit again. Add a daily check-in to review your whole day, and with Pro, up to three reminders per habit.

STATISTICS, STREAKS, AND NOTES
Watch your current streak grow, chase your best streak, and set streak goals for extra motivation. Dive into completion statistics and monthly charts, manage past days in the calendar, and add a short note to any day: what went well, what got in the way.

MAKE IT YOURS
Give every habit its own color and icon, or use any emoji. Organize your dashboard with categories and filters, reorder everything with drag and drop, and pick light, dark, or system theme, including a pure black mode for OLED screens.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Your habit data stays on your device, and the app works completely offline.

HABITKIT PRO
HabitKit is free to use with up to four habits, including streaks, statistics, notes, and reminders. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, home screen widgets, import and export backups, restoring archived habits, and up to three reminders per habit. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or pay once and keep Pro forever with the lifetime option. Every upgrade supports an independent developer. Start free, see if the grid pulls you in, and upgrade whenever you are ready.

You do not need a new life. You need one small habit and a place to see it grow. Download HabitKit and place your first tile today.

QUICK CHECK INS

- Start mornings with quick mood checks and energize your pet to go exploring! Choose from a variety of quick mindful habits from goal tracking and bullet journaling to mindful breathing exercises and quizzes!
- End days in moments of gratitude with your self-care pet where they'll be back from adventures to share stories with you! Destress, reflect, and recognize your positive moments.

MINDFUL EXERCISES

Strengthen your mental health by increasing resilience, productivity, and gratitude with self-care exercises! Finch helps you hit goals and sustain healthy habits with your self-care pet!

- Goal Tracker: set goals and celebrate wins you've accumulated from healthy habits.
- Bullet Journaling: guided bullet journaling prompts to clear the mind, track important moments, and practice gratitude.
- Breathing: guided breathing to calm nerves, increase focus, energize your mind, and sleep better.
- Quizzes: quick quizzes to understand your mental health by tracking your anxiety, depression, body image appreciation, and more.
- Mood Tracker: check on yourself and access mood trends to understand what has been lifting you up or bringing you down.
- Quotes: read motivational quotes to lift your mood and gain new perspective.
- Sleep: Unwind yourself for good sleep with guided breathing and next day goal planning.
- Insights: get insights on your mental health from combined analytics on your mood tracker, bullet journal tags, goal tracker, and quizzes.

"description":"Learn languages fluently with Pimsleur - Learn to speak 50+ foreign languages like a local with just 30 minutes of language learning practice a day!

The Pimsleur Method™ is the most effective way to learn a foreign language, achieve native conversational fluency, and use the language in your everyday life. Learn to speak fluent Spanish, French, Korean, German, Chinese, Arabic, Japanese and more with ease. Pimsleur’s language learning resources make learning a language fun, flexible and rewarding. Practice speaking fluently with just 30 minutes of language practice a day! 

For 50 years, we’ve been helping people rapidly learn languages in 30 days. Want to learn Spanish to speak to Mexican friends? Need to learn Japanese for a trip to Tokyo? Choose from over 50 languages to learn while driving, at the gym, or while cooking. No Internet needed with offline mode. Plus the built-in hands-free mode makes it easy to learn a new language anywhere, anytime, even in the car!

Our innovative online audio lessons focus on enhancing your vocabulary, pronunciation and speaking skills without the burden of grammar tables, making language learning and practice enjoyable and accessible. Dive into cultural topics that enrich your understanding and language fluency, and join thousands of adults who have transformed their language skills online with Pimsleur.

Whether you're a beginner or already looking to improve your language fluency, Pimsleur offers a convenient and effective online language learning platform for adults designed for a flexible study schedule that fits into your daily routine. Learn to speak a new language anytime, anywhere - even in the car as a family. 

Why Choose Pimsleur as Your Language Partner?
- Scientifically proven method for fast, lasting language fluency.
- Just 30 minutes a day to speak a new foreign language with confidence.
- Learn languages offline, hands-free, and without distractions, no Wi-Fi needed.
- Perfect your pronunciation and practice real conversations with a smart AI language tutor. 
- Sync across devices to track your progress and keep your learning streak going.
- Join the global community of Pimsleur language learners!

Discover the full list of language courses here: Albanian, Eastern, Egyptian or Modern Standard Arabic, Eastern or Western Armenian, Cantonese or Mandarin Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dari Persian, Dutch, Farsi Persian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Haitian Creole, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Ojibwe, Pashto, Polish, European or Brazilian Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Latin American or Spain-Castilian Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Swiss German, Tagalog, Thai, Turkish, Twi, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese.

FREE TRIAL AVAILABLE
Don’t miss out - try Pimsleur for FREE and start learning different languages today! With a complimentary lesson in 51 languages, you'll experience the most effective way to achieve conversational fluency from Day 1.

PREMIUM FEATURES
CORE CONVERSATIONAL LANGUAGE LEARNING LESSONS
Enjoy 30-minute conversational language lessons anywhere. Quickly learn to speak another language in just 30 days!

READ
You won’t just learn foreign languages; you'll learn to read without sacrificing speaking skills!

SPEAK
Don't be shy! Learn to speak fluently with conversation partner role-play & review transcripts using AI language learning & voice recognition. Now available for Spanish learners.

SKILLS
Practice phrases by topic & learn easily with visual language learning through vocabulary flashcards. Learn foreign languages with Quick Match & Speed Rounds.

SYNC PROGRESS
Track learning progress across different devices, sync & stream offline with no ads.

Whether you’re learning to get confident having new conversations, for a higher grade, a career boost, or for mind-blowing travel experiences, Busuu’s got your back.

– Show off achievements with official certificates

BETTER SLEEP

AFFORDABLE THERAPY

Featured as a 2026 pick for the App Store “App of the Day”

Thousands worldwide call Waking Up life changing. Whether you want better sleep, more clarity, or deeper meditation, Waking Up is your complete guide.

Testimonials

“Waking Up has led to my most consistent meditation practice. Family and staff also use it because it’s such a powerful tool.” —Andrew Huberman, neuroscientist

“Waking Up is a critical part of my daily practice. It’s my go-to for presence, peace, and well-being.” —Rich Roll, athlete & author

“If you’ve had trouble getting into meditation, this app is your answer!” —Susan Cain, best-selling author

What’s Inside

- Introductory Course—a transformative 28-day program, for both beginners and experienced meditators
- Daily Meditations—regular guided sessions with Sam Harris
- Daily Quotes—a spark of insight each day
- Daily Wisdom—brief lessons that shift perspective
- Moment—short reflections when you need them most
- Sleep—talks and meditations to help you rest
- Meditation Timer—customize your own sessions
- A vast library of meditations, theory sessions, life courses, conversations, and Q&As
- Community—connect with members to discuss meditation, philosophy, psychedelics, and more
- CarPlay—listen to select sessions and conversations while you drive.

Why Waking Up Stands Out

Unlike conventional meditation apps, Waking Up blends practice with theory—so you not only learn to meditate but also understand how it transforms your mind. It’s meditation, science, and timeless wisdom in one place.

Topics & Techniques

Our library combines contemplative traditions with modern science, offering tools for both practice and understanding. Techniques include mindfulness (Vipassana), Loving-Kindness, body scans, yoga nidra, and nondual awareness practices from Dzogchen, Zen, and Advaita Vedanta. Content & Teachers

- Practice—Vipassana, Zen, Dzogchen, Advaita Vedanta (Joseph Goldstein, Diana Winston, Adyashanti, Henry Shukman, Richard Lang)

- Q&As—Sam Harris with Joseph Goldstein, Adyashanti, Henry Shukman, Jack Kornfield, Loch Kelly
	
And many more subjects and teachers.

Created by Sam Harris

Free for Anyone Who Can’t Afford It

We never want money to be the reason someone can’t benefit from our app. To learn about our scholarship program, reach out to support@wakingup.com.

• Drag and drop to reorder items—organize your to-dos exactly how you want them.
• Enjoy the satisfying experience of checking off completed tasks as you get things done.
• Perfect for shopping lists, daily chores, project tasks, and everything in between.

[ NOTES ]
• Create unlimited text notes with rich formatting—quickly and easily.
• Tap anywhere to start typing—it's simple, fast, and always saved automatically.
• Works perfectly in both light and dark mode.

[ RICH TEXT FORMATTING ]
• Style your notes with bold, italic, underline, and strikethrough.
• Choose from 7 text colors and 7 highlight colors to make important details stand out.
• Pick from 18 handpicked font families—each with proper bold and italic variants.
• A convenient formatting toolbar sits right above the keyboard for fast access.
• Switch fonts anytime—your existing formatting is preserved.

[ HANDWRITTEN NOTES WITH APPLE PENCIL ]
• Capture your thoughts naturally with fluid, responsive handwriting that feels like pen on paper.
• Create beautiful handwritten notes, diagrams, and drawings with realistic ink flow and pressure sensitivity.
• Choose from fountain pens, pencils, and highlighters with customizable colors for a personalized writing experience.
• Enjoy our adaptive paper grid that works perfectly in any orientation or device.

[ FOLDERS - ORGANIZE YOUR NOTES ]
• Organize notes into folders and subfolders with a clean, nested structure.
• Assign a unique color to each folder, making it simple to categorize and find notes at a glance.
• Drag-and-drop to reorder, and move multiple notes easily.

[ PIN & SORT NOTES ]
• Pin important notes to the top and sort by date, custom order, or alphabetical order.

[ BACKUP WITH ICLOUD ]
• Keep notes safe with automatic backups and iCloud sync across your devices.

[ PERSONALIZE YOUR NOTEPAD ]
• Give your notepad a personal touch with unique app icons, custom colors, stylish fonts, and a sleek dark mode for night owls.

[ FIND NOTES FAST ]
• Use advanced search tools and text highlighting to track down exactly what you're looking for.

[ KEEP YOUR NOTES SAFE ]
• Lock your notes with FaceID or TouchID for extra privacy.

[ SHARE & PRINT ]
• Send your notes to other apps like Mail or WhatsApp, or print them directly from Notepad.

[ PREMIUM FEATURES FOR POWER USERS ]
• Go ad-free, unlock exclusive themes, and get advanced sorting options with Premium.

"description":"Goodnotes has always been the place to capture your ideas — from quick notes to big plans. Now, it goes further. With powerful AI and new ways to capture information, Goodnotes helps you connect the dots, unlock insights, and turn ideas into action.
*Existing Goodnotes 5 users can continue to use Goodnotes 5 indefinitely or upgrade to the new Goodnotes. Either way, your notes are safe!* 

For professionals: Increase productivity at work
■ Whiteboard + Goodnotes AI: Brainstorm, mind-map, and diagram freely on an infinite canvas that grows with your ideas. Enhanced diagramming tools and real-time collaboration make it easy for teams to workshop & ideate together, while Goodnotes AI helps you capture and organize key takeaways instantly.
■ Goodnotes AI Audio & Meetings: Stay fully present in every conversation while Goodnotes does the work for you. AI-powered transcription and live summarization automatically capture discussions and turns them into clear meeting minutes. After the meeting, merge transcripts with your own handwritten or typed notes to create polished, shareable documents in seconds.
■ Text Documents + AI: Create documents that think with you. Enjoy a superior typing experience with rich inline blocks, build on ideas with external insights, and collaborate seamlessly with teammates. With AI-powered summarization, automated note generation, and transcript support, turn rough notes and meetings into finished content faster than ever.
■ Present your notes, slides, and content directly from Goodnotes when you connect your device via AirPlay or HDMI to an external screen.
■ Use Laser Pointer to guide your audience's attention during your presentation.
■ Export your handwritten and typed notes to email, print, or share them anywhere as PDFs.
■ Send a link to your notebooks to work on the same notes.
■ Import documents by emailing them to your custom Goodnotes email.

For students: Ace your exams with ease
■ Record audio notes that are magically synced to your iPhone or iPad exact moment you write: perfect for lectures, seminars, and presentations.
■ Take handwritten notes that stay fully searchable: instantly find any word across every class notebook, even mid-lecture.
■ Study and practice straight from your notes with study Sets: flashcards built on active recall and spaced repetition.
■ Use AI to summarize, shorten, change the tone of your words, and turn messy handwritten or typed student notes into polished, structured study material.

For planners and journalers: Let your creativity flow
■ Plan your week, month, or year on your iPhone/ iPad with built-in and importable planner templates, fully customizable to match how you plan.
■ Keep a daily journal alongside your planner. Combine handwriting, typed reflections, photos, and stickers on the same page.
■ Use Goodnotes AI to summarize a week's worth of journal entries on your iPhone or iPad into key themes and takeaways.
■ Customize the size and color of your paper templates to create the planner or journal you want.
■ Add, create, or import stickers, stamps, washi tapes, images, and more on your iPad.

Digital notebooks: unlimited notebooks for the price of a single physical one
■ Combine handwriting and typed text on one page, alongside images, stickers, diagrams, and doodles.
■ Create digital notebooks, planners, and journals with customizable paper templates, including Blank Paper, Ruled Paper, Cornell Paper, Checklists, Planners, and more.
■ Navigate long documents with ease. PDF tables of contents are automatically imported, or create custom outlines yourself.
■ Back up all your handwritten and typed notes to Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive, and use iCloud to sync across iPad, iPhone, and Mac — so your notes are always safe.
■ Edit your handwriting by resizing it, changing the text color, or moving it to another spot on the page.

"description":"Supercharge your productivity with OneNote. Organize thoughts and ideas, and simplify planning important moments with your digital note-taking. Smart notes on your phone can sync across all your devices with Microsoft OneNote.

Combine the power of digital ink with the natural feel of a pen to help you sketch out your inspirations. Take smart notes and capture every detail with voice transcription. Our writing tools make it easy to capture your notes, review your content later, and access AI studying.

Take smart notes, share writing ideas, organize note-taking, and collaborate on your creative ideas and writing - all with Microsoft OneNote.

ONENOTE APP FEATURES: 

AI-POWERED COPILOT NOTEBOOKS
• Make sense of your files with AI chat
• Summarize meetings, classes, and discussions easily from your notes
• Listen to audio overviews, created directly from the notes you take

AI NOTE-TAKING WITH HOMEPAGE AND QUICK CAPTURE
• Streamlined writing: Find notes from your connected accounts in one place to easily create, find, & act on your notes. Now with Samsung Notes integration.
• AI workflows with Copilot: Capture text, voice, ink or images to your notepad with Quick Capture
• Smart notes: Capture smart notes in ink. Click the pen button & write down thoughts

"description":"Uni:Note is a handwritten note app with a clean, simple, ad-free UI designed to feel like writing in a real college notebook.
Supervised by current university students, it is built around what actually feels comfortable and practical during classes.

When you open the app, you can immediately start writing with Apple Pencil.
The interface is designed to minimize unnecessary operations so you can stay focused on writing.

Notes can be organized by subject and managed page by page for easy review.
Pages are separated clearly while still allowing you to continue writing naturally.

Uni:Note supports portrait mode, landscape mode, and multiwindow use.
You can attach images or PDFs, write directly on them, or add notes beside them.

In Vertical Notebook Mode, PDFs can be displayed full-screen for annotation and class handout markup.

Documents captured with the camera can also be corrected and attached instantly.

Your notes naturally connect to review and studying.
You can hide marked sections for memorization review or generate practice questions using the Learning Assistant (AI).

With “Circle to Solve,” you can simply circle a problem in your notes and have the Learning Assistant (AI) help solve it.

Uni:Note also supports recording, real-time transcription, and AI summaries.
You can record lectures while taking notes and review the content later in an organized way.

With the companion app “Uni:Note Pocket,” you can review your notes anytime.

Backup and restore are also supported, so you can continue using your important notes safely.

■ Privacy
Uni:Note collects and uses in-app identifiers that do not directly identify individual users in order to manage remaining usage for AI features and purchase status.
When the app crashes, Uni:Note collects diagnostic information such as crash logs for troubleshooting purposes.
Crash logs do not include information that directly identifies individual users, note contents, audio contents, transcription contents, or the contents of attached data.
Uni:Note does not collect device information except for diagnostic information such as crash logs and information necessary to manage AI feature usage limits and purchase status.
Collected information is used only to manage AI feature usage and improve app quality.

■ Main Features
• College notebook-style page design
• Automatic page creation while writing
• Organize notes by subject
• Write on images and PDFs
• Automatic document correction and attachment
• Zoom support
• Support for different screen sizes and orientations
• Multiwindow support
• Open two Uni:Note windows side by side
• Vertical ruled lines and Vertical Notebook Mode
• PDF annotation support
• Audio recording
• Real-time transcription
• AI summaries (Learning Assistant)
• Memorization marker
• Circle to Solve (Learning Assistant)
• Practice question generation (Learning Assistant)
• Ruler tool
• Select and move note areas
• Subject sorting
• Note sorting
• Uni:Note Pocket integration
• PDF export
• Backup and restore

"description":"From your first lecture to your next big meeting, Notability helps you think, learn, and work better. Take handwritten notes, annotate documents, record audio, and stay organized in one place so your ideas are always clear, searchable, and ready when you need them.

NEW: NOTABILITY CLASSIC IS BACK
Prefer to pay one time for Notability? Our Classic plan is a one-time purchase with no subscription required.

FREE DIGITAL NOTES FOR WORK & SCHOOL
• Write, type, or sketch with digital ink, highlighters, and text tools.
• Mark up anything: PDFs, textbooks, lecture slides, images, and more.
• Combine handwriting, typed text, images, diagrams, and sketches on the same page.
• Stay organized with customizable folders and subjects that grow with you.

FOR PROFESSIONALS: WORK SMARTER AND SAVE TIME
• Mark up documents, capture meetings, organize ideas, and present with confidence.
• Import and handwrite on any document: PDFs, DOCs, presentations, reports, and more.
• Fill out forms in the office or on a job site.
• Combine handwriting, text, photos and documents in one place.
• Record calls and meetings to transcribe voice in real-time. Audio is synced to your notes so nothing is missed.
• Receive automated meeting notes, takeaways, and summaries.
• Search handwriting, transcripts, text, and PDFs to quickly revisit decisions and action items.
• Present notes, documents, and ideas in full screen, with a laser pointer to guide attention.

• Mixer - combine multiple sounds with individual volume

SOFTEN: Adjust the tone of each sound to suit your needs with Soften, which reduces the high frequencies of any sound by an amount you choose. This makes the sound seem as if it is coming from another room or outside, as sometimes you want to sleep with rain outside, not pouring on your head. Your chosen levels for Soften are stored when you save a Mix to your Favorites to help you create the perfect scenes.
